notes.title: Small Update - 03.12.23
notes.notes:
The ability to change clothes through the inventory is enabled.
 Fixed Hotkeys for quickly using items that restore health (4-8).
 If the map or inventory is open, Escape allows you to close them.
 Fixed a bug where the offer to "Replenish Erogenous Energy" disappeared.
 Fixed a bug due to which the list of missions was hidden in the inventory.
